name: Churn baseline
config_yaml:
sources:
- name: ontology_entities
  role: entity
  relation: ontology.entities
  description: Active food-service facilities (DirtyDuck tutorial)
  type_column: facility_type
  version_label: dirtyduck-v1
  knowledge_date_column: start_time
- name: ontology_events
  role: event
  relation: ontology.events
  description: Food inspection events with result and violations (DirtyDuck tutorial)
  type_column: type
  version_label: dirtyduck-v1
  knowledge_date_column: date
grid_config:
  sklearn.dummy.DummyClassifier:
    strategy:
    - prior
  sklearn.tree.DecisionTreeClassifier:
    max_depth:
    - 3
    - 5
    min_samples_split:
    - 50
  sklearn.ensemble.RandomForestClassifier:
    max_depth:
    - 3
    n_estimators:
    - 10
    min_samples_split:
    - 50
  triage.component.catwalk.baselines.thresholders.SimpleThresholder:
    rules:
    - - COUNT(inspections.result) > 5
  triage.component.catwalk.baselines.rankers.BaselineRankMultiFeature:
    rules:
    - - feature: COUNT(inspections.result)
        low_value_high_score: false
  triage.component.catwalk.estimators.classifiers.ScaledLogisticRegression:
    C:
    - 0.01
    - 1.0
    penalty:
    - l2
    max_iter:
    - 1000
label_config:
  name: failed_inspections
  query: "select\n  entity_id,\n  bool_or(result = 'fail')::integer as outcome\nfrom\
    \ ontology.events\nwhere {as_of_date}::date <= date\n  and date < {as_of_date}::date\
    \ + {label_timespan}\ngroup by entity_id\n"
problem_type: classification
task_framing: resource_prioritization
cohort_config:
  name: active_facilities
  query: 'select e.entity_id

    from ontology.entities as e

    where e.activity_period @> {as_of_date}::date

    '
feature_config:
  target: facilities
  entities:
  - id: entity_id
    alias: facilities
    table: ontology.entities
    variables:
      facility:
        role: identifier
        type: text
      zip_code:
        role: categorical
        type: categorical
        vocabulary:
        - '60647'
        - '60657'
        - '60614'
        - '60611'
        - '60608'
        - '60618'
        - '60622'
        - '60607'
        - '60639'
        - '60625'
        - '60623'
        - '60640'
      facility_type:
        role: categorical
        type: categorical
        vocabulary:
        - restaurant
        - grocery store
        - school
        - unknown
        - children's services facility
        - bakery
        - daycare (2 - 6 years)
        - daycare above and under 2 years
        - liquor
        - long term care
        - catering
        - mobile food preparer
        - mobile food dispenser
        - daycare combo 1586
        - hospital
  - id: null
    alias: inspections
    table: ontology.events
    variables:
      risk:
        type: categorical
      type:
        type: categorical
      result:
        type: categorical
    temporal_ix: date
  intervals:
  - P1M
  - P3M
  - P6M
  max_depth: 2
  relationships:
  - child:
      key: entity_id
      entity: inspections
    parent:
      key: entity_id
      entity: facilities
    temporal:
      mode: as_of
temporal_config:
  label_end_time: '2017-07-01'
  test_durations: 0day
  feature_end_time: '2017-07-01'
  label_start_time: '2015-01-01'
  feature_start_time: '2014-01-01'
  test_label_timespans:
  - 6month
  max_training_histories: 5year
  model_update_frequency: 6month
  training_label_timespans:
  - 6month
  test_as_of_date_frequencies: 6month
  training_as_of_date_frequencies: 6month
imputation_config:
  all:
    type: zero
  count:
    type: zero_noflag
